questions.text: Should the indoor temperature be kept at 22 °C from 2016-01-25 18:00 until your guests leave (or until 2016-01-26 00:00 if you prefer)?
When do you want the dishwasher and washing machine to finish by? (For example, before 18:00 or later?)

explanation: The gateway will keep the house at 22 °C from 18:00 tonight to make it cosy for your guests. It will use the cheapest hours (23:00–04:00) to charge the car and cover the heat demand with solar power where possible.
